# Outlines from the live site

Trimmed page outlines (Ctrl+Shift+D) that back each selector in
`adapters/disneyplus.json`. Files here end in `.txt` and hold structure only:
no titles, names, links or text. `test/adapter-evidence.test.ts` rebuilds a
page from each and checks the adapter's selectors against it.

None yet: the adapter is empty until the live site has been walked.
